hygiene_items_check_has_status.name: hygiene_items_check_has_status
hygiene_items_check_has_status.value: "hygiene_items"."kind" <> 'CHECK' or ("hygiene_items"."status" is not null and "hygiene_items"."celsius" is null)

hygiene_items_temperature_has_celsius.name: hygiene_items_temperature_has_celsius
hygiene_items_temperature_has_celsius.value: "hygiene_items"."kind" <> 'TEMPERATURE' or ("hygiene_items"."celsius" is not null and "hygiene_items"."status" is null)

time_entries_distances_non_negative.name: time_entries_distances_non_negative
time_entries_distances_non_negative.value:
("time_entries"."started_distance_meters" is null or "time_entries"."started_distance_meters" >= 0)
        and ("time_entries"."ended_distance_meters" is null or "time_entries"."ended_distance_meters" >= 0)
        and ("time_entries"."started_accuracy_meters" is null or "time_entries"."started_accuracy_meters" >= 0)
        and ("time_entries"."ended_accuracy_meters" is null or "time_entries"."ended_accuracy_meters" >= 0)
